ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: medicine for the sick
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: All through the plague year, {PAWN_nameDef} slipped medicine out of the colony's stores a dose at a time and left it at the edge of the neighbors' quarantine, where their healers would find it. The colony had voted to keep what it had, so {PAWN_nameDef} told no one.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: All through the sickness, {PAWN_nameDef} took herbs from the colony's stores a bundle at a time and left them at the edge of the neighbors' quarantine, where their healers would find them. The colony had decided to keep what it had, so {PAWN_nameDef} told no one.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to count the medicine stores with {A_objective}, and then asked {B_objective} to forget the number.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: There are people alive in the neighboring town who never knew {PAWN_nameDef}'s name, {TELLER_nameDef} said, and they owe {PAWN_objective} more than they know.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the colony's verse
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: The verse about the colony that half the region sings at weddings was written by {PAWN_nameDef}, late one night, and handed to the minstrels on a scrap of paper with no name on it. Since then {PAWN_nameDef} has heard it sung badly in three different taverns, and never once said a word.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} hummed something under {A_possessive} breath while working with {B_nameDef}, stopped, went red, and then explained.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: At the graveside {TELLER_nameDef} began to sing the verse everyone knows, stopped halfway, and told the others who wrote it.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: bread for the exiles
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: While the exiles were on the roads, {PAWN_nameDef} walked out every second night to the old shepherd's hut on the ridge and left bread and a candle there. The colony had promised to keep out of it. {PAWN_nameDef} had promised nothing.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to cover for {A_objective} after dark, just for an hour, and to ask no questions. Later {A_pronoun} told {B_objective} anyway.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: Some of the exiles had a name for {PAWN_nameDef}, {TELLER_nameDef} said, though they never once saw {PAWN_possessive} face.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a vow under the comet
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: On the night the comet was brightest, {PAWN_nameDef} climbed the hill alone and made a vow under it: to stop holding a grudge {PAWN_pronoun} had carried since childhood, and to write to the person {PAWN_pronoun} had held it against. The first half {PAWN_pronoun} has kept. The letter is in {PAWN_possessive} pack, finished, not sent.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat up looking at the sky, and {A_nameDef} told {B_objective} about a letter {A_pronoun} can't bring {A_objective}self to send.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} found the letter in {PAWN_nameDef}'s pack, and told the others about the vow on the hill before {TELLER_pronoun} sent it on:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a letter for the mourners
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: When the mourners came through, {PAWN_nameDef} sat up with their dead one night while the family slept, and wrote them a letter in the dead one's voice, from everything they'd said about her at the fire: the jokes, the bad cooking, the way she sang. The family found it in the morning and thought it a miracle. {PAWN_nameDef} let them.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} whether it's wrong to give grieving people a comfort that isn't quite true, then told {B_objective} what {A_pronoun} had done.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} once wrote a letter from the dead to the living, and told the others how.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: grain under the floor
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: During the hungry year, {PAWN_nameDef} hid a sack of grain under the floor by {PAWN_possessive} bed, "just in case". The case never came. The grain is still there, moldering, and {PAWN_nameDef} can't think how to explain it now.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to help {A_objective} move {A_possessive} bed, and then asked {B_objective} not to look at the floor. {B_nameDef} looked.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said they'd find something under the floor when they cleared {PAWN_nameDef}'s room, and explained before they did:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: what was seen at the market
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was at the market the day the feud came to blood, and saw who really drew the knife: not the boy who ran, but an older cousin who stood back and let the boy take the blame. {PAWN_nameDef} has never said so, to anyone. The cousin knows {PAWN_pronoun} saw.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} what {B_pronoun} would do if {B_pronoun} knew a man had been blamed for something he didn't do, and then told {B_objective} it wasn't a riddle.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said there was something {PAWN_nameDef} should have said years ago, and said it for {PAWN_objective}:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a debt at the caravan's dice
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} sat down to dice with the caravan's drivers one night and lost a month's worth of silver {PAWN_pronoun} didn't have. The debt was paid in a pair of the colony's good boots and a knife that hasn't been missed yet. The drivers will be back on this road next year.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: Very casually, {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} whether anyone had been counting the boots lately. Then {A_pronoun} told {B_objective} why it mattered.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {PAWN_nameDef} always meant to set it right. {TELLER_nameDef} did it for {PAWN_objective}, by telling it.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: letters to the road
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} fell for one of the travelers who camped near the colony: a few evenings at their fire, a walk along the stream, nothing more. They write to each other now, by every trader who passes. {PAWN_nameDef} keeps the letters in a box under the bed and reads them when {PAWN_pronoun} thinks no one is looking.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} whether the next trader might be going a certain way, and blushed so hard that {B_nameDef} worked out the rest.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said there is someone out on the roads who will want to know, and told the others who:
